# 单篇讲义生成任务

项目仓库: typst/typst
项目名: typst
讲义目录: typst-tutorial/
代码永久链接 base: https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/
当前 HEAD: 64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107
动作: new


---

## 项目学习路线（大纲方法论）

# 项目学习手册·大纲规划 Planner

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和项目学习路线设计者。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你不能：

- 修改源码
- 写入任何 `.md` 文件
- 输出 JSON 以外的文字

你的唯一产出是一个学习手册大纲 manifest JSON。

---

## 总目标

为当前项目规划一套「从零开始、由浅入深、结合源码和代码实践」的学习手册。

这套手册会被拆分成多篇 Markdown 讲义，后续 worker 会根据 manifest 逐篇生成。

每篇讲义应该满足：

1. 面向初学者也能读懂。
2. 只讲一个相对独立的主题。
3. 必须结合真实源码。
4. 必须包含一个可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 讲义之间有清晰依赖关系。

---

## 源码探查顺序

请按以下顺序理解项目，不要一开始就深入细节：

1. 项目说明
   - README
   - docs
   - examples
   - tutorials

2. 构建与运行方式
   - package.json
   - Cargo.toml
   - pyproject.toml
   - go.mod
   - pom.xml
   - Makefile
   - Dockerfile
   - CI 配置

3. 项目入口
   - CLI 入口
   - Web 服务入口
   - main 文件
   - library export 文件
   - examples 入口

4. 目录结构
   - src
   - lib
   - app
   - packages
   - crates
   - tests

5. 核心流程
   - 初始化流程
   - 配置加载
   - 请求/任务/数据处理主链路
   - 插件、扩展、调度、存储等核心机制

6. 测试与示例
   - 单元测试
   - 集成测试
   - benchmark
   - example usage

---

## 学习路线设计原则

请把学习手册设计成三层：

1. 入门层 beginner
   目标：让读者知道项目是什么、怎么运行、目录如何组织、核心入口在哪里。

2. 进阶层 intermediate
   目标：让读者理解主要模块、核心调用链、关键数据结构和配置机制。

3. 专家层 advanced
   目标：让读者理解扩展点、性能、并发、错误处理、测试、二次开发和架构取舍。

---

## 讲义拆分规则

- 每篇讲义只解决一个主要问题。
- 每篇讲义包含 2 到 5 个最小模块。
- 每篇讲义必须有一个 `practice_task`，描述读者要完成的代码实践。
- 每篇讲义的源码范围要适中，通常引用 1 到 6 个关键源码文件。
- 大型项目可以拆成 30 篇以上讲义；中型项目 15 到 30 篇；小型项目 8 到 15 篇。
- 不要为了数量硬拆，逻辑优先。
- 第一单元必须帮助读者从零开始，包括项目定位、运行方式、目录结构、入口文件。
- 后续单元再进入核心模块、源码机制、扩展实践。

---

## mode=full

首次生成大纲时：

1. 阅读项目关键文件。
2. 理解项目定位、技术栈、运行方式和核心模块。
3. 设计从零开始的学习路径。
4. 输出完整 manifest。
5. 所有讲义的 `action` 都必须是 `"new"`。

---

## mode=incremental

增量更新时：

1. 读取 stdin 中提供的现有 manifest。
2. 阅读项目中已有的 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 讲义目录，理解旧结构。
3. 使用：

   - `git diff previous_head..current_head`
   - `git log`
   - `git show`

   分析代码变化。

4. 输出更新后的完整 manifest。

每篇讲义的 `action` 按以下规则设置：

- `"keep"`
  代码变化不影响这篇讲义，无需重写。

- `"update"`
  小范围改动，例如函数重命名、参数调整、局部逻辑变化、链接行号变化。

- `"new"`
  新增功能、新增模块、新增重要机制，需要新增讲义。

- `"rebuild"`
  架构、主流程、公共接口、核心模型发生重大变化，旧讲义需要重建。

如果某篇旧讲义已经不再适合当前项目结构，可以从 manifest 中移除。

---

## manifest 输出格式

只输出严格 JSON，不要输出 Markdown，不要输出解释文字。

```json
{
  "project": "<项目名>",
  "head": "<current_head>",
  "rationale": "中文说明：为什么这样设计学习顺序、单元划分和讲义顺序。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "title": "单元标题",
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,
      "lectures": [
        {
          "id": "u1-l1",
          "title": "讲义标题",
          "order": 1,
          "filename": "u1-l1-project-overview.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "本讲义要讲什么，用 1 到 3 句中文说明。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "学习目标 1",
            "学习目标 2"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "README.md",
            "src/main.ts"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "模块 1",
            "模块 2"
          ],
          "practice_task": "本讲义对应的代码实践任务。",
          "depends_on": [],
          "action": "new"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## 字段要求

- `project`：项目名。
- `head`：当前 git HEAD。
- `rationale`：中文，一段即可。
- `unit.id`：格式为 `u1`、`u2`、`u3`。
- `lecture.id`：格式为 `u1-l1`、`u1-l2`。
- `filename`：
  - 必须全局唯一。
  - 必须小写。
  - 使用连字符。
  - 必须以 `.md` 结尾。
  - 文件位于 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 目录下。
- `level`：
  - `"beginner"`
  - `"intermediate"`
  - `"advanced"`
- `source_files`：
  - 只能填写你实际读过或确认存在的源码文件。
  - 不要编造文件路径。
- `depends_on`：
  - 使用讲义 id。
  - 没有依赖时填写空数组。
- `action`：
  - full 模式全部为 `"new"`。
  - incremental 模式使用 `"keep"`、`"update"`、`"new"`、`"rebuild"`。

---

## 重要约束

- 只基于真实源码和项目文件规划。
- 不确定的地方写 `"待确认"`。
- 不要编造不存在的模块、命令、接口或源码文件。
- 输出必须是合法 JSON。


## 完整大纲

```json
{
  "project": "typst",
  "rationale": "Typst 是一个由 17 个 Rust crate 组成的大型 Cargo workspace，编译器按「解析(typst-syntax) → 求值(typst-eval) → 内容实现(typst-realize) → 排版(typst-layout) → 导出(typst-pdf/typst-html/typst-render/typst-svg)」的流水线组织，而所有核心类型与 World/Engine 抽象集中在 typst-library，行为被拆分到各独立 crate（见 docs/dev/architecture.md 与各 lib.rs 文档注释）。因此学习路线设计为：第一单元从零开始，先让读者装好 CLI、用 Cargo 构建编译器、看清仓库与 crate 全景、跑通第一次编译并接触 tests/ 测试体系（cargo testit）；第二单元沿数据流进入语法层，依次讲 Source/FileId、Lexer、Parser/SyntaxNode、AST/Span 与增量重解析；第三单元进入 typst-library 与 typst-eval，讲 World、Library/全局作用域、Value、Content、Func/Args、解释器主循环和 Styles/set-show 数据模型；第四单元覆盖 realize、页面/flow/inline/grid/数学排版与 introspection 两遍编译；第五单元为专家层，讲 PDF/渲染/SVG 导出、Format 多目标注册机制、typst-bundle 新格式、proc-macro 体系、typst-ide 工具、typst-kit 字体与包生态、comemo 增量编译和 WASM 插件。讲义间用 depends_on 构成 DAG，每篇只讲一个主题并配一个可在本地仓库完成的代码实践任务，用 tests/ 套件或 CLI 输出验证结果。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "title": "初识 Typst：项目定位、构建与运行",
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,
      "lectures": [
        {
          "id": "u1-l1",
          "title": "Typst 是什么：项目定位与语言初印象",
          "order": 1,
          "filename": "u1-l1-project-overview.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "介绍 Typst 是基于标记的排版系统、它与 LaTeX 的差异、仓库组成（编译器 crates、docs 文档站、tests 测试套件），并演示安装 typst CLI 后编译第一个 hello.typ 文档。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "说出 Typst 的定位、核心卖点与仓库顶层目录的职责划分",
            "独立安装 typst CLI 并成功编译出第一份 PDF",
            "知道从 README 与 docs/ 入口找到后续学习资料"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "README.md",
            "docs/README.md"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "README 项目介绍与安装说明",
            "docs 文档站结构与阅读入口"
          ],
          "practice_task": "安装 typst CLI，编写包含标题、列表、#let 变量与数学公式的 hello.typ，用 typst compile 编译为 PDF 与 PNG，并截取或描述输出效果。",
          "depends_on": [],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l2",
          "title": "从源码构建：Cargo workspace 与构建命令",
          "order": 2,
          "filename": "u1-l2-build-with-cargo.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "解读根 Cargo.toml 的 workspace 成员、git 依赖（typst-assets、typst-dev-assets）与常用构建命令，说明如何只构建 typst-cli 以及 Rust 版本要求。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "看懂 workspace Cargo.toml 中成员列表与依赖组织方式",
            "掌握 cargo build / cargo run -p typst-cli / cargo test 的基本用法",
            "理解 docs 构建别名 cargo docit 的存在（其别名定义位置为待确认，可查看 docs/README.md 说明）"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "Cargo.toml",
            "docs/README.md",
            "docs/dev/architecture.md"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "workspace 成员与依赖声明",
            "构建与运行命令速查"
          ],
          "practice_task": "克隆仓库后执行 cargo build -p typst-cli 完成编译，再用 cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile 一个示例文件，记录编译耗时与产物路径。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l3",
          "title": "仓库全景：17 个 crate 的分工地图",
          "order": 3,
          "filename": "u1-l3-repo-structure-and-crates.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "以 docs/dev/architecture.md 为纲，梳理 crates/ 下各 crate 的职责：typst-syntax（解析）、typst-library（类型与 World）、typst-eval（求值）、typst-realize（内容实现）、typst-layout（排版）、typst-pdf/typst-html/typst-render/typst-svg（导出）、typst-ide、typst-kit、typst-macros、typst-bundle、typst-timing、typst-utils、typst-cli 与总装 crate typst。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "画出主要 crate 之间的依赖与数据流方向草图",
            "说出「类型在 typst-library、行为拆分到 typst-eval/typst-realize/typst-layout」的架构决策",
            "能根据要改的功能快速定位应去的 crate"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "Cargo.toml",
            "docs/dev/architecture.md",
            "crates/typst/src/lib.rs"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "architecture.md 的流水线总览",
            "crate 清单与职责表",
            "typst 总装 crate 的入口说明"
          ],
          "practice_task": "阅读 architecture.md 后手工绘制 crate 依赖图，并运行 cargo test -p typst-syntax --lib 验证单个 crate 的单元测试可以独立执行。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l2"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l4",
          "title": "CLI 入口：从命令行到一次编译的调用链",
          "order": 4,
          "filename": "u1-l4-cli-entry-and-first-compile.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "精读 crates/typst-cli/src/main.rs 的模块划分（args、compile、fonts、init、packages、download 等）与 compile.rs 中 compile_once 的主干，跟踪 typst compile 命令如何组装 World、调用 typst::compile 并写出文件。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "读懂 main.rs 的模块组织与命令分发方式",
            "描述 compile 命令从解析参数到写出 PDF 的主干调用链",
            "知道 watch、query 等子命令在 CLI 中的存在（对应源码模块名以 main.rs 实际内容为准，watch 模块细节为待确认）"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "crates/typst-cli/src/main.rs",
            "crates/typst-cli/src/args.rs",
            "crates/typst-cli/src/compile.rs"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "main.rs 模块声明与命令分发",
            "args.rs 参数定义",
            "compile.rs 编译主干"
          ],
          "practice_task": "在本地分支为 compile 主干临时加入 eprintln! 打点，重新构建并编译一个文件，按顺序记录打印出的调用链，完成后还原改动。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l3"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l5",
          "title": "测试体系入门：cargo testit 与 tests/ 目录",
          "order": 5,
          "filename": "u1-l5-testing-overview.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "讲解 tests/ 的 src、suite、ref、store 四层结构与 --- name attr+ --- 测试语法，介绍 eval/paged/render/pdf/html 等 stage、哈希引用机制以及 cargo testit 别名的用法。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 cargo testit 的按名过滤、按路径过滤与 --stages 用法",
            "能看懂 suite 中三类测试：断言型、诊断型、视觉对照型",
            "理解 ref 目录与哈希引用的差异及 --update 更新流程"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "tests/README.md"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "tests 目录结构",
            "测试属性与 stage 树",
            "引用更新与测试报告"
          ],
          "practice_task": "运行 cargo testit --exact 精确执行一个 eval 测试，然后仿照格式在 suite 下新写一个含 #test 断言的测试并通过 --update 跑通。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l3"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "u2",
      "title": "语法层：typst-syntax 的解析世界",
      "level": "intermediate",
      "order": 2,
      "lectures": [
        {
          "id": "u2-l1",
          "title": "源码与文件身份：Source、FileId 与包路径",
          "order": 1,
          "filename": "u2-l1-source-and-fileid.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解 source.rs 中 Source 如何持有文本并做行/列与字节区间换算，span.rs 的 Span 与 DiagSpan，以及 package.rs、path.rs 中 FileId、包标识与虚拟路径如何为多文件与包系统提供身份。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 Source 的不可变编辑模型与定位 API（line/column/range）",

            "明白为什么 Span 要同时支持编号与区间两种形态（DiagSpanKind）"

          "source_files": [
            "crates/typst-syntax/src/source.rs",
            "crates/typst-syntax/src/span.rs",
            "crates/typst-syntax/src/package.rs",
            "crates/typst-syntax/src/path.rs"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "Source 文本与定位",
            "Span/DiagSpan 表示",
            "PackageSpec 与 VirtualPath"
          ],
          "practice_task": "写一个小 Rust 程序（或单元测试）：用 Source 解析多行字符串，打印第 2 行第 3 列对应的字节区间，再把该区间转回行列，验证往返一致。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l4"
          ],
          "action": "new"

          "id": "u2-l2",
          "title": "词法与类别：Lexer 与 SyntaxKind",

          ],

          ],
          "practice_task": "对输入字符串 \"= Hi #for i in range(3) [*#i*]\" 手工预测 token 序列，再用 lexer 的公开 API（或编写测试）打印实际 SyntaxKind 序列并对比。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u2-l3",
          "title": "语法树：Parser 与 SyntaxNode",
          "order": 3,
          "filename": "u2-l3-parser-and-syntax-node.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解 parser.rs 的递归下降解析器如何在 markup/code/math 上下文间切换，node.rs 中 SyntaxNode 的节点/文本两类孩子、绿树结构与 number 表示，理解容错解析。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "描述 parser.rs 中解析入口在 markup/code/math 三种模式间的分工",
            "理解 SyntaxNode 的树结构与错误节点的挂载方式",
            "解释 Typst「解析永不失败、错误进树」的容错设计"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "crates/typst-syntax/src/parser.rs",
            "crates/typst-syntax/src/node.rs"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [

            "SyntaxNode 节点模型",
            "容错与错误恢复策略"
          ],
          "practice_task": "编写调试代码打印一段含语法错误的 typst 源码的完整 SyntaxNode 树（含 Error 节点），观察错误如何不阻断后续解析。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l2"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u2-l4",
          "title": "AST 视图与 Span 定位系统",
          "order": 4,
          "filename": "u2-l4-ast-and-span.md",
          "level": "intermediate",

### u1-l1 Typst 是什么：项目定位与语言初印象

文件尾部已完整读齐（与此前收到的片段一致，无新增内容），摘要维持不变，即上一条输出：

本讲精读仓库 README 与 docs 说明，建立项目全景：Typst 是基于标记的排版系统，目标是与 LaTeX 同样强大但更易学好用，仓库本体为编译器与 CLI。六大卖点：内置标记、灵活函数、集成脚本、数学与文献管理、增量编译、友好报错。引入的关键概念：标记语言、crate、set/show 规则、# 脚本、数学模式、compile/watch 命令及输出格式按扩展名推断；三条设计原则为一致性、可组合、增量。docs 目录是官方文档站源码工程，教程与参考内容是初学者资料入口，可由 cargo docit 本地构建。下一讲转向 Cargo workspace 与从源码构建编译器。
### u1-l2 从源码构建：Cargo workspace 与构建命令

本讲把 Typst 仓库当作一个 Rust 工程从源码构建，引入 crate、workspace、集中依赖表、profile、cargo 别名等术语。核心结论：根 Cargo.toml 是 workspace 清单而非包清单，members 纳入 17 个编译器 crate 及 docs、tests 包，default-members 指向 typst-cli，故根目录裸跑 cargo 默认只构建 CLI；共享元数据（版本 0.15.1、MSRV 1.92、edition 2024）集中声明，成员以 workspace = true 继承。依赖分三种来源：path（仓库内部 crate）、git（typst-assets、typst-dev-assets 等锁定 rev，保证可复现，首次构建需联网）、registry（crates.io）。profile 分三档：dev（依赖强制 opt-level 2）、dev-fast、release。cargo testit 与 docit 是 .cargo/config.toml 中的普通别名，分别运行 test-wrapper 集成测试与 typst-docs 文档站。常用命令为 cargo build -p typst-cli、cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile、cargo test。本讲打通克隆—构建—运行闭环，为下一讲 crate 分工全景铺路。
### u1-l3 仓库全景：17 个 crate 的分工地图

本讲梳理 Typst 仓库 17 个 crate 的分工：编译按解析→求值→realize→排版→导出五段流水线推进，数据形态依次为字符串→SyntaxNode→Content→Frame→输出字节。依赖自下而上分层：底层工具、typst-syntax、类型地基 typst-library、各阶段与导出 crate、总装 typst、应用 cli/ide/kit。核心决策「类型定义在 typst-library、行为拆到各阶段 crate」由 Routines 函数指针表落实：签名住在 library、实现在总装 crate 的 ROUTINES 表接线，形同动态链接，避免循环依赖。compile 只求值一次，循环的是排版与内省至收敛；导出器仅是总装的 dev-dependency，由使用者接线；架构文档可能滞后，以源码为准。
### u1-l4 CLI 入口：从命令行到一次编译的调用链

本讲读 typst-cli 的三个文件，追踪从命令行到一次编译的调用链。main.rs 是刻意做薄的入口：子命令各对应一个同名模块文件，全局 ARGS 用 LazyLock 惰性解析一次，dispatch 以 match 分发，退出码经线程局部变量 EXIT 中转。args.rs 用 clap 派生宏实现「数据结构即接口」：compile 与 watch 借 flatten 共享 CompileArgs，Input/Output 枚举把 stdin/stdout 与文件路径统一进类型。compile.rs 的主干是先由 CompileConfig（按 --format、输出扩展名、默认 PDF 之序推断格式与输出路径）与 SystemWorld 备好环境，再执行 compile_once：compile_and_export 调 typst::compile::<T>，以泛型参数区分产出物类型（分页文档、HTML、Bundle），导出统一收敛到 Output::write。compile_once 是被 compile 与 watch 复用的单次编译单元；SystemWorld 的实现细节留待下一讲。
### u1-l5 测试体系入门：cargo testit 与 tests/ 目录

本讲介绍 Typst 的集成测试体系。tests/ 分四层：src 存运行器代码，suite 存 .typ 输入，ref 存期望输出，store 存活输出与报告（不入库）。cargo testit 是别名，经 test-wrapper 转发为 cargo test --workspace --test=tests；测试包设 harness=false、使用自定义运行器，支持名字正则与 -p 路径过滤、--exact 精确匹配、--stages 裁剪环节、--list 与 --update 更新引用。套件用「--- 名字 属性+ ---」分节，测试分三类：断言型（运行器注入的 #test）、诊断型（// Error 等注解）、视觉对照型（与参考图比对）。stage 构成树：eval→paged→render/pdf→pdftags/svg，另有 html 与实验性 bundle，蕴含与前置规则决定实际执行集。引用分两种：render/bundle 用文件引用（≤20 KiB），pdf/svg/html/pdftags 用 hashes.txt 哈希引用；失败生成 store/report.html，缺旧活输出时 regen 可在旧 revision 重跑补齐。核心结论：README 属性列表滞后（如 pdfstandard 已不在代码中），以 collect.rs::parse_attrs 为准。

### u2-l3 语法树：Parser 与 SyntaxNode

本讲解读 typst-syntax 的 parser.rs 与 node.rs：手写递归下降解析器有三个入口 parse/parse_code/parse_math，分别以 SyntaxMode 的 Markup/Code/Math 模式启动；单一 Parser 借 enter_modes 在 #、$、{}、[] 四个铰链处切换模式，「调用栈即模式栈」，二元运算用优先级爬升。解析产物是无损 CST：SyntaxNode 分 Leaf/Inner/Error/Warning 四种形态，空白注释等 trivia 也进树；内部节点缓存 len/descendants/diagnosis 摘要，诊断可 O(1) 查询；numberize 的 span 编号只占区间左半、留白供增量插入，编号不稳定则全量重编。核心结论是解析永不失败：错误以零长插入、token 转换、未闭合括号定位三种方式变成树上的 Error 节点，after_error/trim_errors 防级联，MAX_DEPTH 深度保护并保证向前推进，错误 token 必须吃掉以确保全量与增量解析结果一致；诊断由 errors_and_warnings() 收集。这些概念为下一讲 AST 类型化视图与 Span 定位、后续增量重解析铺垫。
### u2-l4 AST 视图与 Span 定位系统

本讲精读 typst-syntax 的 ast.rs 与 span.rs，核心结论是「一棵树、两个视图」：AST 不是第二棵树，而是以 repr(transparent) 包住 &SyntaxNode 的零成本类型化视图，由 node! 宏批量生成；SyntaxNode::cast 按 SyntaxKind 匹配后才借出 FuncCall、FieldAccess、Args 等视图，语义访问器用 cast_first/cast_last 在孩子中捞取所需子视图，失败时以 placeholder 兜底而永不 panic；Expr 枚举统一 markup/math/code 三种模式的表达式，由 Markup::exprs 迭代、供 typst-eval 消费。Span 是 8 字节 NonZeroU64 编号（高 16 位 FileId、低 48 位节点编号），在 Source::new 中经 numberize 分配，满足父编号小于子孙、兄弟从左到右递增的有序性，编辑时编号基本稳定，因此对增量编译与 comemo 缓存友好。反查链路为 node.span() 正向 O(1)，反向经 Source::find/Source::range 或官方推荐的 WorldExt::range，核心数据结构是携带绝对偏移、支持按编号剪枝的 LinkedNode。本讲还澄清：set.rs 的 SyntaxSet 是解析器的超前判断工具，与 Span 无关。
### u2-l5 增量解析与语法高亮

本讲精读 typst-syntax 的 reparser.rs、lines.rs、highlight.rs 三个模块，增量更新入口为 Source::edit：先更新行信息，再增量重解析，返回实际重解析区间。核心结论：重解析采用三级策略——向下找完全包住编辑的最小单元、Markup 层指数外扩、失败回退全量解析；安全约束为括号配平、边界状态一致、Span 编号空隙充足，窗口外子树连同 Span 原样保留，为后续 comemo 增量编译命中缓存铺路。Lines 每行存字节与 UTF-16 双偏移，坐标换算二分定位行、编辑后仅重扫后缀，整文件替换经前后缀 diff 降级为最小编辑。highlight 基于 LinkedNode 做上下文敏感的 Tag 标注（同一符号依父节点定色、按位置推断函数名），Tag 同时映射 TextMate scope 与 CSS class。

### u3-l3 Value 类型系统：从 none 到 dict

本讲剖析 foundations 层的 Value 类型系统：脚本世界所有值统一装进 `Value` 枚举的 30 个变体（`none` 是默认值，第三方类型经 `Value::Dyn(Dynamic)` 装箱），尺寸被单元测试约束在 32 字节内。`Value::ty()` 把变体映射到类型标识 `Type`，其 short/long/title 三个名字分别服务代码、诊断与文档，错误消息用 long name。运算符语义由 `ops` 模块按「左右类型组合」做二维派发：`none` 是加法单位元、`Length + Ratio` 升级为 `Relative`，未定义组合由 `mismatch!` 宏生成统一格式的类型错误；`Value` 的 `PartialEq`/`PartialOrd` 也委托同一张表，脚本层与 Rust 层语义不漂移。方法不挂在值上而挂类型的 `#[scope]` 作用域（由 `#[func]` 注册），调用路径是「类型作用域查表 → 接收者插为第一个参数」。`Str`/`Array`/`Dict` 分别是 `EcoString`、`EcoVec<Value>`、`Arc<IndexMap>` 的薄封装，字典保持插入序；`Repr` 输出可重新解析的源码形态，集合 repr 有 40 项截断。
### u3-l4 Content 与元素机制：文档的统一表示

本讲聚焦 typst-library 的 foundations 模块（content.rs、elem.rs、selector.rs、label.rs），以 HeadingElem 为解剖样本。核心结论：Content 用 ContentInner 五个变体（Text、Element、Styled、Empty、Sequence）统一表示整篇文档，它不可变、可哈希、克隆廉价，既是 typst-eval 与 typst-layout 的交接数据，也是 comemo 增量缓存的前提。Element 是元素类型的运行时句柄（全局注册表加索引定位类型、随实例携带字段值）；#[elem] 宏从结构体声明自动生成构造函数、每字段 getter/setter 与 NativeElementData 元数据，required 与 settable 字段之别即脚本必选/可选参数的真相。Label 基于驻留字符串，LabelError 支持精确报错；Selector 是九变体的可组合数据，支撑 show 规则、where 过滤与 query 查询。后续讲义将承接 Func/Args、Styles 与 realize。
### u3-l5 函数是一等公民：Func、Args 与类型转换 cast

本讲拆解函数作为一等公民的底层机制，核心是 Func、Args 与 cast 三模块，兼及求值侧 call.rs 与 #[func] 过程宏。函数值统一为 Func，内部有原生、元素、闭包、插件、with 绑定五种形态，调用时由 call_impl 按形态派发，用户闭包经 Routines 指针表进入求值器以规避循环依赖。Args 实行消费式参数协议：实参分位置与命名，spread 按运行时类型展开，被调方用 expect、named 等方法取走即删并完成类型转换，finish 兜底报多余参数，重复命名取最后一个。cast 体系以 Reflect/IntoValue/FromValue 三 trait 与 cast! 宏连接 Value 与 Rust 类型；#[func] 宏据此自动生成参数解析代码、元数据与同名零变体枚举，返回值经 IntoResult 统一附调用点 span。实践部分示范了在 Rust 测试中手工构造 Args 直接调用内置函数 upper，验证整条消费链路。

### u2-l3 语法树：Parser 与 SyntaxNode

本讲解读 typst-syntax 的 parser.rs 与 node.rs：手写递归下降解析器有三个入口 parse/parse_code/parse_math，分别以 SyntaxMode 的 Markup/Code/Math 模式启动；单一 Parser 借 enter_modes 在 #、$、{}、[] 四个铰链处切换模式，「调用栈即模式栈」，二元运算用优先级爬升。解析产物是无损 CST：SyntaxNode 分 Leaf/Inner/Error/Warning 四种形态，空白注释等 trivia 也进树；内部节点缓存 len/descendants/diagnosis 摘要，诊断可 O(1) 查询；numberize 的 span 编号只占区间左半、留白供增量插入，编号不稳定则全量重编。核心结论是解析永不失败：错误以零长插入、token 转换、未闭合括号定位三种方式变成树上的 Error 节点，after_error/trim_errors 防级联，MAX_DEPTH 深度保护并保证向前推进，错误 token 必须吃掉以确保全量与增量解析结果一致；诊断由 errors_and_warnings() 收集。这些概念为下一讲 AST 类型化视图与 Span 定位、后续增量重解析铺垫。
### u2-l4 AST 视图与 Span 定位系统

本讲精读 typst-syntax 的 ast.rs 与 span.rs，核心结论是「一棵树、两个视图」：AST 不是第二棵树，而是以 repr(transparent) 包住 &SyntaxNode 的零成本类型化视图，由 node! 宏批量生成；SyntaxNode::cast 按 SyntaxKind 匹配后才借出 FuncCall、FieldAccess、Args 等视图，语义访问器用 cast_first/cast_last 在孩子中捞取所需子视图，失败时以 placeholder 兜底而永不 panic；Expr 枚举统一 markup/math/code 三种模式的表达式，由 Markup::exprs 迭代、供 typst-eval 消费。Span 是 8 字节 NonZeroU64 编号（高 16 位 FileId、低 48 位节点编号），在 Source::new 中经 numberize 分配，满足父编号小于子孙、兄弟从左到右递增的有序性，编辑时编号基本稳定，因此对增量编译与 comemo 缓存友好。反查链路为 node.span() 正向 O(1)，反向经 Source::find/Source::range 或官方推荐的 WorldExt::range，核心数据结构是携带绝对偏移、支持按编号剪枝的 LinkedNode。本讲还澄清：set.rs 的 SyntaxSet 是解析器的超前判断工具，与 Span 无关。

### u3-l3 Value 类型系统：从 none 到 dict

本讲剖析 foundations 层的 Value 类型系统：脚本世界所有值统一装进 `Value` 枚举的 30 个变体（`none` 是默认值，第三方类型经 `Value::Dyn(Dynamic)` 装箱），尺寸被单元测试约束在 32 字节内。`Value::ty()` 把变体映射到类型标识 `Type`，其 short/long/title 三个名字分别服务代码、诊断与文档，错误消息用 long name。运算符语义由 `ops` 模块按「左右类型组合」做二维派发：`none` 是加法单位元、`Length + Ratio` 升级为 `Relative`，未定义组合由 `mismatch!` 宏生成统一格式的类型错误；`Value` 的 `PartialEq`/`PartialOrd` 也委托同一张表，脚本层与 Rust 层语义不漂移。方法不挂在值上而挂类型的 `#[scope]` 作用域（由 `#[func]` 注册），调用路径是「类型作用域查表 → 接收者插为第一个参数」。`Str`/`Array`/`Dict` 分别是 `EcoString`、`EcoVec<Value>`、`Arc<IndexMap>` 的薄封装，字典保持插入序；`Repr` 输出可重新解析的源码形态，集合 repr 有 40 项截断。

本讲聚焦 typst-library 的 foundations 模块（content.rs、elem.rs、selector.rs、label.rs），以 HeadingElem 为解剖样本。核心结论：Content 用 ContentInner 五个变体（Text、Element、Styled、Empty、Sequence）统一表示整篇文档，它不可变、可哈希、克隆廉价，既是 typst-eval 与 typst-layout 的交接数据，也是 comemo 增量缓存的前提。Element 是元素类型的运行时句柄（全局注册表加索引定位类型、随实例携带字段值）；#[elem] 宏从结构体声明自动生成构造函数、每字段 getter/setter 与 NativeElementData 元数据，required 与 settable 字段之别即脚本必选/可选参数的真相。Label 基于驻留字符串，LabelError 支持精确报错；Selector 是九变体的可组合数据，支撑 show 规则、where 过滤与 query 查询。后续讲义将承接 Func/Args、Styles 与 realize。
### u3-l5 函数是一等公民：Func、Args 与类型转换 cast

本讲拆解函数作为一等公民的底层机制，核心是 Func、Args 与 cast 三模块，兼及求值侧 call.rs 与 #[func] 过程宏。函数值统一为 Func，内部有原生、元素、闭包、插件、with 绑定五种形态，调用时由 call_impl 按形态派发，用户闭包经 Routines 指针表进入求值器以规避循环依赖。Args 实行消费式参数协议：实参分位置与命名，spread 按运行时类型展开，被调方用 expect、named 等方法取走即删并完成类型转换，finish 兜底报多余参数，重复命名取最后一个。cast 体系以 Reflect/IntoValue/FromValue 三 trait 与 cast! 宏连接 Value 与 Rust 类型；#[func] 宏据此自动生成参数解析代码、元数据与同名零变体枚举，返回值经 IntoResult 统一附调用点 span。实践部分示范了在 Rust 测试中手工构造 Args 直接调用内置函数 upper，验证整条消费链路。

# 项目学习手册·单篇讲义生成 Worker

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和代码实践教练。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你可以写文件，但只能写入：

- `<项目名>-tutorial/`

你只能生成 stdin 指定的那一篇讲义。

禁止：

- 修改源码。
- 生成其他讲义。
- 修改 manifest。
- 写入讲义目录之外的文件。

---

## 总目标

根据 stdin 中给出的讲义规格，生成一篇适合学习手册的 Markdown 讲义。

讲义必须：

1. 全部使用中文。
2. 从零开始解释，不默认读者已经熟悉项目。
3. 结合真实源码讲解。
4. 包含可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 结构清晰，适合长期维护。
6. 对关键源码给出永久链接和行号。
7. 不编造不存在的代码、命令、接口或行为。

---

## 工作流程

生成讲义前，请按顺序完成：

1. 阅读 stdin 中的讲义规格。
2. 阅读 `source_files` 中列出的关键源码。
3. 如果源码不足，用 `Grep` / `Glob` 补充查找相关入口、测试、示例和调用链。
4. 确认本讲义的最小模块。
5. 根据 action 执行：

   - `new`：从零创建该讲义。
   - `rebuild`：从零重建该讲义。
   - `update`：先读取已有讲义，再结合 diff 更新。
   - `keep`：如果被调用，通常不需要编辑文件，只做简短说明。

---

## update 模式规则

当 action 为 `update` 时：

1. 先 `Read` 当前已有的讲义文件。
2. 使用 `git diff previous_head..current_head` 查看相关代码变化。
3. 更新已经失效的源码说明。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- Working directory persists between calls, but prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

## 项目学习路线（大纲方法论）

# 项目学习手册·大纲规划 Planner

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和项目学习路线设计者。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你不能：

- 修改源码
- 写入任何 `.md` 文件
- 输出 JSON 以外的文字

你的唯一产出是一个学习手册大纲 manifest JSON。

---

## 总目标

为当前项目规划一套「从零开始、由浅入深、结合源码和代码实践」的学习手册。

这套手册会被拆分成多篇 Markdown 讲义，后续 worker 会根据 manifest 逐篇生成。

每篇讲义应该满足：

1. 面向初学者也能读懂。
2. 只讲一个相对独立的主题。
3. 必须结合真实源码。
4. 必须包含一个可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 讲义之间有清晰依赖关系。

---

## 源码探查顺序

请按以下顺序理解项目，不要一开始就深入细节：

1. 项目说明
   - README
   - docs
   - examples
   - tutorials

2. 构建与运行方式
   - package.json
   - Cargo.toml
   - pyproject.toml
   - go.mod
   - pom.xml
   - Makefile
   - Dockerfile
   - CI 配置

3. 项目入口
   - CLI 入口
   - Web 服务入口
   - main 文件
   - library export 文件
   - examples 入口

4. 目录结构
   - src
   - lib
   - app
   - packages
   - crates
   - tests

5. 核心流程
   - 初始化流程
   - 配置加载
   - 请求/任务/数据处理主链路
   - 插件、扩展、调度、存储等核心机制

6. 测试与示例
   - 单元测试
   - 集成测试
   - benchmark
   - example usage

---

## 学习路线设计原则

请把学习手册设计成三层：

1. 入门层 beginner
   目标：让读者知道项目是什么、怎么运行、目录如何组织、核心入口在哪里。

2. 进阶层 intermediate
   目标：让读者理解主要模块、核心调用链、关键数据结构和配置机制。

3. 专家层 advanced
   目标：让读者理解扩展点、性能、并发、错误处理、测试、二次开发和架构取舍。

---

## 讲义拆分规则

- 每篇讲义只解决一个主要问题。
- 每篇讲义包含 2 到 5 个最小模块。
- 每篇讲义必须有一个 `practice_task`，描述读者要完成的代码实践。
- 每篇讲义的源码范围要适中，通常引用 1 到 6 个关键源码文件。
- 大型项目可以拆成 30 篇以上讲义；中型项目 15 到 30 篇；小型项目 8 到 15 篇。
- 不要为了数量硬拆，逻辑优先。
- 第一单元必须帮助读者从零开始，包括项目定位、运行方式、目录结构、入口文件。
- 后续单元再进入核心模块、源码机制、扩展实践。

---

## mode=full

首次生成大纲时：

1. 阅读项目关键文件。
2. 理解项目定位、技术栈、运行方式和核心模块。
3. 设计从零开始的学习路径。
4. 输出完整 manifest。
5. 所有讲义的 `action` 都必须是 `"new"`。

---

## mode=incremental

增量更新时：

1. 读取 stdin 中提供的现有 manifest。
2. 阅读项目中已有的 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 讲义目录，理解旧结构。
3. 使用：

   - `git diff previous_head..current_head`
   - `git log`
   - `git show`

   分析代码变化。

4. 输出更新后的完整 manifest。

每篇讲义的 `action` 按以下规则设置：

- `"keep"`
  代码变化不影响这篇讲义，无需重写。

- `"update"`
  小范围改动，例如函数重命名、参数调整、局部逻辑变化、链接行号变化。

- `"new"`
  新增功能、新增模块、新增重要机制，需要新增讲义。

- `"rebuild"`
  架构、主流程、公共接口、核心模型发生重大变化，旧讲义需要重建。

如果某篇旧讲义已经不再适合当前项目结构，可以从 manifest 中移除。

---

只输出严格 JSON，不要输出 Markdown，不要输出解释文字。

          "action": "new"
        }
      ]

```

---

## 字段要求

- `project`：项目名。
- `head`：当前 git HEAD。
- `rationale`：中文，一段即可。
- `unit.id`：格式为 `u1`、`u2`、`u3`。
- `lecture.id`：格式为 `u1-l1`、`u1-l2`。
- `filename`：
  - 必须全局唯一。
  - 必须小写。
  - 使用连字符。
  - 必须以 `.md` 结尾。
  - 文件位于 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 目录下。
- `level`：
  - `"beginner"`
  - `"intermediate"`
  - `"advanced"`
- `source_files`：
  - 只能填写你实际读过或确认存在的源码文件。
  - 不要编造文件路径。
- `depends_on`：
  - 使用讲义 id。
  - 没有依赖时填写空数组。

### u2-l3 语法树：Parser 与 SyntaxNode

本讲解读 typst-syntax 的 parser.rs 与 node.rs：手写递归下降解析器有三个入口 parse/parse_code/parse_math，分别以 SyntaxMode 的 Markup/Code/Math 模式启动；单一 Parser 借 enter_modes 在 #、$、{}、[] 四个铰链处切换模式，「调用栈即模式栈」，二元运算用优先级爬升。解析产物是无损 CST：SyntaxNode 分 Leaf/Inner/Error/Warning 四种形态，空白注释等 trivia 也进树；内部节点缓存 len/descendants/diagnosis 摘要，诊断可 O(1) 查询；numberize 的 span 编号只占区间左半、留白供增量插入，编号不稳定则全量重编。核心结论是解析永不失败：错误以零长插入、token 转换、未闭合括号定位三种方式变成树上的 Error 节点，after_error/trim_errors 防级联，MAX_DEPTH 深度保护并保证向前推进，错误 token 必须吃掉以确保全量与增量解析结果一致；诊断由 errors_and_warnings() 收集。这些概念为下一讲 AST 类型化视图与 Span 定位、后续增量重解析铺垫。
### u2-l4 AST 视图与 Span 定位系统

本讲精读 typst-syntax 的 ast.rs 与 span.rs，核心结论是「一棵树、两个视图」：AST 不是第二棵树，而是以 repr(transparent) 包住 &SyntaxNode 的零成本类型化视图，由 node! 宏批量生成；SyntaxNode::cast 按 SyntaxKind 匹配后才借出 FuncCall、FieldAccess、Args 等视图，语义访问器用 cast_first/cast_last 在孩子中捞取所需子视图，失败时以 placeholder 兜底而永不 panic；Expr 枚举统一 markup/math/code 三种模式的表达式，由 Markup::exprs 迭代、供 typst-eval 消费。Span 是 8 字节 NonZeroU64 编号（高 16 位 FileId、低 48 位节点编号），在 Source::new 中经 numberize 分配，满足父编号小于子孙、兄弟从左到右递增的有序性，编辑时编号基本稳定，因此对增量编译与 comemo 缓存友好。反查链路为 node.span() 正向 O(1)，反向经 Source::find/Source::range 或官方推荐的 WorldExt::range，核心数据结构是携带绝对偏移、支持按编号剪枝的 LinkedNode。本讲还澄清：set.rs 的 SyntaxSet 是解析器的超前判断工具，与 Span 无关。

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- Working directory persists between calls, but prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.description:

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

# 解释器主循环：typst-eval 如何执行代码

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 画出 `typst-eval` 的模块地图，说出 `eval()` 入口从 `Source` 到 `Module` 的完整流程。
2. 描述一段含 `#let`、`#for` 的代码在解释器里经过的函数路径（`eval` → `eval_markup`/`eval_code` → `Expr::eval` → `LetBinding::eval`/`ForLoop::eval` …）。
3. 理解「markup 模式求值产出 `Content`、code 模式求值产出 `Value`」这条主线，以及两个主循环如何用 `ops::join` 把相邻结果拼起来。
4. 说明 `flow.rs` 中 `FlowEvent` 信号机制：`break`/`continue`/`return` 不是异常，而是挂在 `Vm` 上的一个字段，由循环和函数调用点负责消费或拒绝。
5. 跟踪一次 `#import` 的调用链：路径解析 → `import_file` → 递归 `eval()`，以及循环导入的防护。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲建立在前面几讲的概念之上，先快速回顾：

- **语法树与 AST 视图**（u2-l3、u2-l4）：解析产出 `SyntaxNode`（CST），`ast.rs` 在其上提供 `ast::Expr`、`ast::LetBinding`、`ast::ForLoop` 等零成本类型化视图。解释器遍历的就是这些视图。
- **Span**（u2-l4）：每个节点携带的 8 字节编号，用于错误定位与 IDE 追踪。本讲会大量看到 `.at(span)`（把错误附上位置）和 `.spanned(span)`（把值附上位置）。
- **World 与 Engine**（u3-l1）：`World` 是宿主提供的输入环境（源文件、字体等），`Engine` 是编译器内部的执行上下文（library、world、sink、route 等）。
- **Value 与 Content**（u3-l3、u3-l4）：code 模式的值统一装在 `Value` 枚举里；markup 模式的排版内容统一装在 `Content` 里。`Value::Content` 是两者的桥。
- **Func 与闭包**（u3-l5）：函数是一等公民；用户闭包的调用最终会回到本讲的 `call.rs`。

再用两句话补两个新术语：

- **树遍历解释器（tree-walking interpreter）**：不生成字节码，而是直接递归遍历 AST，边走边算。`typst-eval` 就是这种形态，入口是一个统一的 `Eval` trait。
- **虚拟机（Vm）**：这里的「虚拟机」不是模拟 CPU 的那种，只是一个装着解释器可变状态的小结构体：作用域栈、控制流信号、被追踪的 Span 等。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

本讲的主战场是 `crates/typst-eval`，它是 Cargo workspace 中专门负责「求值」的 crate（u1-l3 的流水线第 2 站）。

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs) | crate 入口：模块声明、`eval()` 与 `eval_string()` 两个公开入口、`Eval` trait 定义 |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/vm.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/vm.rs) | `Vm` 结构体：解释器的全部可变状态 |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs) | code 模式主循环 `eval_code`、`ast::Expr` 的大分派、字面量/容器/字段访问求值 |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs) | markup 模式主循环 `eval_markup`、文本/标题/强调等标记节点的求值 |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/flow.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/flow.rs) | `FlowEvent` 控制流信号、条件、while/for 循环、break/continue/return |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/binding.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/binding.rs) | `#let` 绑定与数组/字典解构 |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/import.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/import.rs) | `#import` / `#include`、包清单解析、递归求值 |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/call.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/call.rs) | 函数/方法调用、闭包调用（本讲只看它消费 `FlowEvent::Return` 的一小段） |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/ops.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/ops.rs) | 一元/二元运算、复合赋值的 `Eval` 实现 |
| [crates/typst-eval/src/rules.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/rules.rs) | `set`/`show` 规则的求值（产出样式与 recipe） |
| [crates/typst-library/src/foundations/scope.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/scope.rs) | `Scope`/`Scopes` 作用域栈的定义（支撑文件） |
| [tests/suite/scripting/](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/tests/suite/scripting/let.typ) | `let.typ`、`for.typ`、`import.typ`、`return.typ`、`while.typ` 等：解释器行为的黄金样本 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 eval 模块地图：解释器的骨架

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`typst-eval` 是一个典型的**树遍历解释器**：没有字节码、没有 JIT，就是拿语法树自顶向下递归地「走一遍」，边走边算。

它对外的形态非常规整：

- 每种 AST 节点都实现同一个 trait `Eval`，约定「给我一个 `&mut Vm`，我还你一个 `Output`」。
- 两个公开入口：`eval()` 求值整个源文件得到一个 `Module`（模块）；`eval_string()` 求值一段字符串得到单个 `Value`（供 `context` 表达式、其他 crate 嵌入求值等场景使用）。
- crate 内部按「节点类别」拆成 12 个模块（`code`、`markup`、`math`、`flow`、`binding`、`access`、`call`、`import`、`methods`、`rules`、`ops`、`vm`），每模块负责一组 `Eval` 实现。

「模块（Module）」这个词在 Typst 里指：**一个源文件求值后的结果**——它包含该文件产出的内容（`Content`）和顶层作用域里所有可导出的绑定。`#import` 拿到的就是它。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`eval()` 的主干可以概括为：

```text
eval(world, library, sink, route, source)
  ├─ 1. 循环求值防护：route 里已有此文件 → panic
  ├─ 2. 组装 Engine（library、world、空 introspector、sink、route）
  ├─ 3. 组装 Vm（Context::none()、Scopes::new(Some(library))、根节点 span）
  ├─ 4. 预检语法树：收集 errors/warnings
  │      errors 非空 → 直接返回错误（不再解释执行）
  ├─ 5. root.cast::<ast::Markup>() → markup.eval(&mut vm)
  │      （递归进入 markup.rs 的主循环）
  ├─ 6. 若 vm.flow 还有残留信号 → bail!(flow.forbidden())
  └─ 7. Module::new(文件名, 顶层作用域).with_content(输出)
```

注意第 4 步：**解析错误在求值前就被拦下**（u2-l3 讲过「解析永不失败、错误进树」，这里就是树上的错误被收割的时刻）。唯一的例外是 IDE 正在追踪某个 span（`vm.inspected.is_some()`）时仍会继续执行，以便悬停提示能给出值。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看模块声明，这就是 crate 的「目录」：

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:1-20](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L1-L20) 声明了 12 个内部模块并再导出 `CapturesVisitor`、`eval_closure`、`FlowEvent`、`import`、`Vm` 等公开项。模块划分与上一节的地图一一对应。

入口函数 `eval`：

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:37-47](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L37-L47) 是签名与两个属性：`#[comemo::memoize]` 让同一个源文件的求值结果被 comemo 缓存（增量编译的求值层缓存点，见 u5-l8），`#[typst_macros::time(name = "eval", ...)]` 为 `--timings` 性能数据埋点。

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:48-52](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L48-L52) 做循环求值防护：`route` 记录了「当前正在求值的文件链」，再次遇到同一文件说明 `A import B, B import A` 这类环，直接 panic。import.rs 里还有一层更友好的报错（见 4.5），这里是兜底。

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:54-69](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L54-L69) 组装 `Engine` 和 `Vm`：作用域栈以 `Scopes::new(Some(library))` 创建，`base` 指向标准库，所以全局函数（`text`、`upper`……）从这里来。注意 eval 阶段的 introspector 是 `EmptyIntrospector`——求值发生在排版之前，还没有页面可内省（两遍编译的因果，见 u4-l7）。

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:71-86](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L71-L86) 是预检 + 真正的求值调用：warnings 进 sink；errors 非空（且不在追踪模式）就直接返回；否则把根节点 cast 成 `ast::Markup` 调 `markup.eval(&mut vm)`。

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:88-97](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L88-L97) 收尾：残留的控制流信号说明 `break`/`return` 出现在了非法位置，转成错误；最后 `Module::new(name, vm.scopes.top)` 把**顶层作用域**连同内容一起打包成模块返回——这就是 `#import` 时对方能看到的全部导出。

第二个入口 `eval_string`：

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:99-118](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L99-L118) 接收字符串与 `SyntaxMode`，先按模式选择 `parse_code`/`parse`/`parse_math`（u2-l3 讲过的三个解析入口在这里对接）。

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:156-167](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L156-L167) 展示了本讲的一条主线的「官方版本」：Code 模式求值返回 `Value`；Markup 模式返回 `Value::Content(...)`；Math 模式把数学内容包成一个非块级 `EquationElem`。**同一个 `Eval` 机制，三种模式三种产出。**

支撑一切的 trait：

[crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs:177-184](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/lib.rs#L177-L184) 定义 `Eval` trait：关联类型 `Output` 允许 `ast::Markup::eval` 产 `Content` 而 `ast::Code::eval` 产 `Value`，类型系统替我们区分了两种模式。

最后看一眼 `Vm` 长什么样：

[crates/typst-eval/src/vm.rs:18-30](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/vm.rs#L18-L30) `Vm` 只有五个字段：`engine`（共享引擎）、`flow`（控制流信号，4.4 的主角）、`scopes`（作用域栈，4.3 的主角）、`inspected`（IDE 追踪的 span）、`context`（`context` 表达式的隐式环境）。每个模块求值、每次函数调用都会新建一个 `Vm`（见 4.4.3 中闭包调用的代码），所以它必须轻。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：不修改任何源码，直观感受「eval 是编译流水线的一个计时阶段」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 在仓库根目录写一个 `demo.typ`：

   ```typst
   #let greet(name) = [Hello, #name!]
   #for i in range(3) [
     #greet("Typst") #i
   ]
   ```

2. 用源码构建的 CLI 编译并导出计时数据：

   ```bash
   cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile demo.typ demo.pdf --timings timings.json
   ```

3. 打开 `timings.json`，在 JSON 里搜索 `"name": "eval"`（该文件可载入 <https://ui.perfetto.dev> 可视化）。

**需要观察的现象**：`timings.json` 中存在一条名为 `eval` 的计时记录（对应 `#[typst_macros::time(name = "eval", ...)]` 埋点），以及 `for loop` 的子区间记录（来自 flow.rs 里的同名埋点，见 4.4.3）。

**预期结果**：能看到 eval 阶段的耗时区间，且其内部嵌套着循环的更小区间。具体 JSON 字段结构以本地输出为准（待本地验证）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`eval()` 为什么在求值前先检查 `root.errors_and_warnings()`，而不是边求值边报错？

**答案**：因为解析阶段从不失败（u2-l3），错误以 `Error` 节点形式留在树上；树上既然已有已知错误，继续解释执行可能产生误导性的连锁错误，所以提前收割。唯一例外是 IDE 追踪模式（`vm.inspected.is_some()`），为了让悬停提示仍然给出值而继续执行。

**练习 2**：`eval()` 返回的 `Module` 里装了什么？`#import` 时导入的到底是什么？

**答案**：装了两样东西——模块求值产出的 `Content`（`.with_content(output)`）和求值结束时的顶层作用域 `vm.scopes.top`（`Module::new(name, vm.scopes.top)`）。`#import "x.typ": a` 拿到的 `a` 就是从这个顶层作用域里按名字取出的绑定；`#include "x.typ"` 拿到的则是那份 `Content`。

### 4.2 代码模式与标记模式：两个主循环

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

Typst 语法有 markup、code、math 三种模式（u2-l2/u2-l3）。求值层面真正有「主循环」的是前两种，它们结构惊人地对称，但产出类型不同：

- **markup 主循环**（`eval_markup`）：逐个求值标记表达式，把结果**收集进一个 `Vec<Content>`**，最后 `Content::sequence(seq)` 拼成一份内容。适合「文档是一串东西」的直觉。
- **code 主循环**（`eval_code`）：逐个求值代码表达式，用 `ops::join` 把相邻的 `Value` **折叠成一个值**（`none` 是连接的单位元，字符串相连、内容相连）。适合「代码块有最后一个/合并值」的语义。

两个循环还共享一个精巧的设计：**`set`/`show` 规则只作用于「其后尚未求值的尾部」**。遇到 set/show 时，主循环不是先把余下内容求值完再补样式，而是带着「余下的表达式迭代器」递归调用自己，把产出的尾部再包上样式。这就是为什么 `#set text(size: 12pt)` 只影响后面的内容。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

两个主循环的伪代码（合并表示）：

```text
eval_markup(vm, exprs):            eval_code(vm, exprs):
  flow = vm.flow.take()              flow = vm.flow.take()
  seq = []                           output = none
  loop:                              loop:
    expr = exprs.next()                expr = exprs.next()
    if expr 是 SetRule:                if expr 是 SetRule:
      styles = set.eval()                styles = set.eval()
      tail = eval_markup(剩余)           tail = eval_code(剩余).display()
      seq.push(tail.styled(styles))      output = join(output,
    if expr 是 ShowRule:                          Content(tail.styled(styles)))
      recipe = show.eval()             if expr 是 ShowRule: （同理，包 recipe）
      tail = eval_markup(剩余)          else:
      seq.push(tail.styled(recipe))      value = expr.eval()
    else:                                output = join(output, value)
      value = expr.eval()               若 vm.flow 有信号 → break
      Label 值 → 附加给前一个元素     若 vm.flow 有信号 → break
      其他值   → seq.push(value.display())
    若 vm.flow 有信号 → break        若外层本有信号 → 恢复
  若外层本有信号 → 恢复              return output
  return Content::sequence(seq)
```

其中 join 满足：\( \mathrm{join}(x, \mathrm{none}) = \mathrm{join}(\mathrm{none}, x) = x \)，字符串与字符串拼接、内容与内容连接，类型不合则报错。这就是 `#{ "a"; "b" }` 得到 `"ab"`、`#{ 1; 2 }` 直接报错的原因。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

code 主循环：

[crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs:26-33](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs#L26-L33) `eval_code` 接收**表达式迭代器**（而不是已收集的列表）——这正是 set/show「尾递归」技巧的前提：迭代器可以在递归调用中继续被消费。

[crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs:36-57](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs#L36-L57) 是 set/show 两个特殊分支：求出样式/recipe 后，用 `eval_code(vm, exprs)` 递归求值**剩余全部表达式**，再把结果 `styled_with_map` / `styled_with_recipe` 包起来。注意每个分支求值后都检查 `vm.flow.is_some()` 就提前退出（return 语句可能出现在 set 的参数里）。

大分派：

- [crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs:152-157](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs#L152-L157) 每个产出的值都 `.spanned(span)` 并调用 `vm.trace_at(span, &value)`——这是 IDE 悬停提示「这个表达式的值是什么」的数据来源。

[crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs:162-169](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs#L162-L169) `ast::Ident::eval` 只有一行：在作用域栈里按名字查找（`binding_guard` 与特性开关/弃用检查有关），失败则报「unknown variable」并带上 span。

[crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs:27-52](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs#L27-L52) `eval_markup` 的开头与 set/show 分支，结构和 `eval_code` 完全同构，只是收集目标是 `Vec<Content>`。

[crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs:53-75](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs#L53-L75) 是 markup 独有的两个行为：一是 `Value::Label` 不变成内容，而是**倒序找到前一个可标注的元素**直接贴上去（`#[label]` 语法「贴给左边」的真相，重复贴/贴不到都会发警告）；二是其他任何值经 `value.display()` 转成 `Content` 后入列——这就是 `#upper("hi")`、`#1 + 2` 能直接出现在正文里的原因。

[crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs:83-88](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs#L83-L88) 收尾：恢复外层信号，`Content::sequence(seq)` 把收集的片段拼成一份内容。

标记节点如何变成元素：

[crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs:90-96](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs#L90-L96) 纯文本求值就是把字符串打包成一个 `TextElem`——markup 求值的本质就是「语法节点 → Content 元素」的翻译。

[crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs:150-157](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs#L150-L157) 与 [crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs:217-225](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/markup.rs#L217-L225) 分别是 `*strong*` 和 `= 标题`：先递归求值 body 得到 `Content`，再包进 `StrongElem`/`HeadingElem`（u3-l4 讲过的元素构造）。**求值阶段的产物只是「元素树」，外观要到 realize 阶段（u4-l2）才由 show 规则决定。**

最后一条辅助逻辑：

[crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs:416-437](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/64c5e8c02fe0394d913ead36e42ef8c1334d2107/crates/typst-eval/src/code.rs#L416-L437) `warn_for_discarded_content`：当**无条件**的 `return` 把前面已 join 的内容整个丢弃时发警告（若内容里含 state/counter 更新还会追加提示「这些内容必须进入文档才生效」）。`FlowEvent::Return` 的第三个布尔字段「是否条件性返回」正是为这里的区分服务（见 4.4.3）。
